name: Thunderbird
description: Thunderbird's comm-central source delegates application updates to Mozilla's shared update service; this review does not substantiate Thunderbird-specific MAR certificate pinning or an independent MAR verification configuration.
limitations: Newly retrieved official Thunderbird mirror default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; the cryptographic updater implementation is inherited from Gecko and Thunderbird-specific release build inputs were not present in comm-central.
The Firefox MAR implementation cannot be transferred to Thunderbird as evidence of its own pinned certificate set.
